name: myreality
description: Reality — Engenharia de Software Sob Medida (myreality.tech)

scripts.serve: node build.mjs --dev && node -e "import('http').then(({createServer})=>import('fs/promises').then(fs=>import('path').then(p=>{const m={'.html':'text/html;charset=utf-8','.css':'text/css','.js':'application/javascript','.svg':'image/svg+xml','.webp':'image/webp','.png':'image/png','.woff2':'font/woff2'};createServer(async(q,s)=>{const u=q.url.split('?')[0]==='/'?'/index.html':q.url.split('?')[0];try{const d=await fs.readFile(p.join(process.cwd(),u));s.writeHead(200,{'Content-Type':m[p.extname(u)]||'application/octet-stream'});s.end(d);}catch{s.writeHead(404);s.end('Not found');}}).listen(5501,()=>console.log('Reality rodando em http://localhost:5501'));})))"

author: Reality · Kayo Santos
